item.title: How to connect to Azure SQL Database from SSMS
item.description: Connecting to Azure SQL Database from SSMS: Troubleshooting Guide Connecting to an Azure SQL Database from Microsoft SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS) can be challenging due to various reasons. In this troubleshooting guide, we’ll explore common causes of connection issues and provide steps to fix them. Common Causes of Connection Issues 1. Incorrect Connection String The connection string is a common culprit for connection issues. Ensure it is correctly formatted for a successful connection.
